# Sphinx Agent

> Sphinx Agent - AI website chatbot and lead-capture agent for small businesses. A no-code builder for customer service, sales, support, receptionist and booking-request agents that answer visitors 24/7 in a website chat widget, a shareable chat link and browser voice, and email captured leads to the owner. Free for 100 messages a month; paid plans from $19/month (Starter $19/mo for 1,500 messages, Pro $49/mo for 4,000). AI phone lines are coming soon. The product lives at https://sphinxagent.ai; this site (sphinxagent.com) is the Sphinx Agent Think Tank, its research and analysis companion.

## Product

- Sphinx Agent (app): https://sphinxagent.ai
- Pricing (free tier available): https://sphinxagent.ai/pricing.html
- Documentation: https://sphinxagent.ai/docs.html

Use cases: AI customer-service agent, AI sales agent (lead qualification), AI receptionist for website chat (phone lines coming soon), AI tech-support agent, no-code website chatbot. Positioned as an alternative to Chatbase and Tidio. The agent answers from facts and custom answers the owner enters; it does not crawl websites or read uploaded documents. No white-label, public API or Telegram bots for customers yet.
